notes.title: update 0.3.3 new weapon update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38766216/82a2ac9467655f9412a26f5221920a0038379076.gif[/img]
update 0.3.3 new weapon update
- new weapon can shot sword beam
- decrease the difficulty of the dragon, giant crab, and Hydra
- difficult level can get more gold
- remove lightning to improve performance

notes.title: big update 0.3 - level up system + new magic weapon system + heath system
notes.content:
- you can equip a weapon and grab your equipped weapon from your back
- you can use gold to buy new weapon and magic
- earn gold after every battle
- 2 new magic
- 2 new weapon
- monsters have a health bar
- kill monster can get exp
- stab and slash on different monster's body part will make different damage
- swing speed can affect attack damage
- show damage number for each attack
- monsters become more difficult when player level up
- you can equip different magic

[b]Roguelike gameplay coming soon[/b]

notes.title: update 0.2.0 (beta branch) new monster Hydra
notes.content:
- new monster Hydra
- falling feel more realistic
- long sword grab angle fixed
- improve telekinesis (make it feel more like B&S)
- disable walking animation while jumping 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38766216/7d665d5cbb0ec3c6e93517d5dbd41cdd81346a20.png[/img]

notes.title: update 0.1.8 new map
notes.content:
the new map is very much like the map we used in Steam Game Festival, but we added more functions to it. you can fully control what monsters you want to fight and how you want to fight them.

- now you can use a shield to punch monster
- make sword swing more fluid
- fixed an avatar disappear bug
- add a new map "collection room". you can spawn any monster at any time from this map and You can enable and disable their AI. Do whatever you want to those monsters.

notes.title: update 0.1.7 ux improvement
notes.content:
- improve telekinesis (easy to pick weapon up)
- add falling speed slider in setting , 
- at lobby scene, make spawn position closer to the monster selection menu
- blood particle performance improvement

notes.title: update 0.1.6 (beta branch) gazer's tentacle as a weapon (works like Nunchaku)
notes.content:
- dagger grab position updated
- toggle for jump vignette
- performance improvement
- sword can stick into the wall
- can chop gazer's tentacle off as a weapon (works like Nunchaku)
- update wilding fighting animation

notes.title: update 0.1.5 temporary fix for low end machine
notes.content: default quality level set as "very low" so the low-end machine can run smoothly
